rule: Rows below supersede/add to V2 where IDs collide. Parent-owned theorems remain parent-owned even when prospectively verified in Track B.

updates.statement: Every finite deterministic adaptive machine over finite state/input/feedback/output sets has an exact finite transition/output table representation; every finite stochastic one has an exact finite Markov-kernel table representation.
updates.consequence: Finite semantic representability cannot establish a fundamental morphology; resource/composition/learning structure must carry the scientific distinction.

updates.statement: In the registered depth-1 two-cell adaptive grammar, cross-cell communication expands exact developmental reach from 95 to 294 classes, while NOT is reach-redundant relative to AND+XOR+constant-1 but lowers mean minimum compilation cost from 7.4081632653 to 6.7721088435.
updates.consequence: Topology can change bounded developmental reach; reach irreducibility and resource irreducibility are distinct.
updates.claim_boundary: Finite shallow state-machine subproblem only; parent formalisms remain sufficient semantically.

updates.statement: Every executed Stage C-v1 structured two-cell morphology compiles exactly to an ordinary finite adaptive transducer/lookup-table parent by tabulating its whole-machine transition and output maps.
updates.consequence: No new low-level computational ontology is earned; morphology science moves to factorization/resource/developmental bias.

updates.statement: One frozen architecture-neutral microbasis compiles registered behavior plus update semantics for tiny neural-like threshold, symbolic-rule, evidence-accumulator and programmatic-register targets without named architecture primitives.
updates.claim_boundary: Generic small program algebra remains a sufficient mundane explanation; probabilistic target is not yet genuinely stochastic.

updates.statement: Without architecture labels, exact version-space elimination over the frozen microbasis can identify the four registered micro behavior/update targets from strict subsets of their truth-table rows.
updates.claim_boundary: Teaching rows are target-aware minimum distinguishing sets; this is teaching-dimension/program-synthesis calibration, not natural morphogenesis.

updates.statement: For a proposal/check/fallback learner with correct proposal rate c, wrong rate w, abstention a, verifier cost V and direct-information cost L, proposal/check is cheaper than direct acquisition iff V/L < c/(c+w), when c+w>0.
updates.claim_boundary: Decision/lifecycle economics parent theorem, not GMI novelty.

updates.statement: In the prospectively frozen 3-bit calibration, target description complexity predicts acquisition-cost separation for an MDL rule proposer at fixed verifier price: SIMPLE mean cost 0.76148, COMPLEX 0.85878.
updates.claim_boundary: Both strata still beat direct memory at V/L=0.25; no full policy crossover.

updates.statement: In the disjoint prospectively frozen 4-bit replication at V/L=0.5, SIMPLE functions favor the MDL proposer (mean cost 0.81459 < 1), while a frozen high-complexity sample favors direct label memory (mean proposer cost 1.01435 >= 1); complex-simple gap 0.19975.
updates.consequence: Calibrates the exact shape required of a D3 ecology/resource -> morphology-region prediction, while leaving cross-paradigm phase law open.
updates.claim_boundary: MDL/version-space/value-of-verification parent policy crossover only; not a new intelligence morphology law.

updates.statement: A mature learner/lens/open-cybernetic parent basis may be sufficient as the low-level compositional adaptive substrate; Track B should only define a new basis if a registered developmental/resource semantic cannot compile into these parents without material loss/overhead.
